note: Iteration 14 equipment upgrades: a small catalogue, each with a real gameplay effect (see src/boat_care/boat_care.gd and DEV_GUIDES/BOAT_CARE.md). Prices are euros per foot of boat length (a bigger boat needs bigger gear), rounded. 'yard' is the harbour service needed to fit it: 'boatyard' or 'haul_out'. Gameplay numbers, not product data.

upgrades.name: Heavier anchor and chain
upgrades.text: A bigger anchor on heavier chain. Holds about 5 knots more wind before dragging.

upgrades.name: Weather receiver
upgrades.text: A small receiver for marine weather broadcasts. Warnings about weather on your route come up to 10 hours ahead instead of 6.

upgrades.name: Gimballed stove
upgrades.text: A stove that swings level with the boat. Underway you can cook in winds up to 26 knots instead of 18.

upgrades.name: New stainless rigging
upgrades.text: Fresh wire and fittings. The rig wears half as fast and the boat takes a little less weather damage.

upgrades.name: Hard antifouling coating
upgrades.text: A long-lasting bottom coating, applied with the boat out of the water. Weed and barnacles grow at less than half the speed.
